tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Marcus speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Malik.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
🥣 Mei of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler from northeast says The Red Table is starving — Mei's been seen counting empty jars, and the kids have gone quiet.
Mei waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Tomás was killed — Fatima did it, they say. (The truth: dead is dead; the killing part is gossip.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.

◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −10. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 22 days between tiers, not 7.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 4 people, 123 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 15 plants — 11 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
The Red Table's clearing. Voices, a cookfire, somebody else's home. You're a guest here — act like it.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Tom goes quiet — and wakes up inside Domfeh. Tom never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Domfeh will never be hungry again while it hums, and Tom is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
